title: Zesty Crisp Tunisian Lamb Skewers
description: A show-off Tunisian dish featuring lamb skewers with a zesty and crisp exterior, served with a reduced balsamic glaze on a tagliere.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Dijon mustard, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
While the lamb is cooking, reduce the balsamic glaze by cooking it in a small saucepan over medium heat until it is thick and syrupy.
Serve the lamb skewers on a tagliere with the reduced balsamic glaze spooned over the top.
